1: Details & Features
The modular storage system is the ideal supplement for compressor units and ensures stable pressure supply for air and Nitrox applications. Available in pressure levels of 330, 350, and 420 bar, it minimizes pressure fluctuations during peak withdrawals and reduces the number of compressor start-ups.: Flexible expansion using 50- or 80-liter storage cylinders allows the system to be tailored precisely to individual demand, supporting smooth and efficient operation.
Storage cylinder with console: A module consists of a storage cylinder that is pre-piped and ready for connection, mounted on a console for floor or wall installation. Based on 50 l or 80 l storage cylinders, these storage systems can be expanded as required.
Pressure vessel: The storage cylinders comply with DGRL2014/68/EU (PED) and are intended for stationary applications.
Condensate drain: Depending on the application or due to insufficient air or gas treatment, condensate can accumulate in high-pressure storage systems. All standard storage vessels from BAUER KOMPRESSOREN are therefore equipped with a manual condensate drain.
Options: Safety valve and pressure gauge
Safety valve and pressure gauge are mounted on the console of the first module. This is mandatory if exceeding the maximum permissible storage pressure cannot be otherwise avoided, e.g. by approved safety valves on the compressor or in the pipeline.: The storage design
Storage system design – the basis for efficient compressor operation: A correctly dimensioned storage system is one of the key components of a high-pressure setup. It reduces pressure fluctuations during intermittent air withdrawal and decreases compressor start frequency by providing sufficient storage capacity. The pressure vessels and final separators in high-pressure compressors are designed for a limited number of load cycles. Fewer start-stop cycles significantly extend the service life of these components.
To ensure optimal operation, the compressor should ideally run no more than two to four cycles per hour. BAUER industrial compressors are equipped with cycle counters as standard, which record actual start cycles and support safe, efficient system control.: The size of the storage system depends on:
Compressor delivery rate (l/min): Air consumption of the specific application
Pressure differential between start and stop (hysteresis): Simplified formula for sizing a high-pressure storage system (based on 4 load cycles/hour):
Vk (l/min): Compressor delivery volume in liters per minute: V (l): Storage volume in liters (water volume)
Δp (bar): Pressure differential (hysteresis) in bar: We recommend a pressure differential Δp of max. 60 bar for continuous operation. Within this range, stationary high-pressure storage cylinders are typically rated for continuous duty. For higher differentials, the number of allowable filling cycles is limited. Please refer to the documentation for the specific pressure vessel.

175 cm × 60 cm × 135 cm: Details & Features
The B-SAFE 300 is a fully enclosed high-pressure filling chamber designed for the simultaneous filling of up to ten breathing air cylinders at pressures of up to 410 bar. Its rugged design and lateral pressure relief ensure maximum safety – without requiring additional protective measures in the room. Operation is via a touchscreen control panel, optionally with a proportional valve for standards-compliant filling of lightweight cylinders.: The B-SAFE ECO is a compact safety chamber designed for direct compressor connection, offering maximum safety with minimal space requirements. Equipped with a mechanical door lock, modern venting technology, and internal pressure relief, it is ideal for container-based and stationary installations. It accommodates up to six breathing air cylinders.
Safety cell: The B-SAFE features an extremely robust steel safety cell that reliably protects against the consequences of bursting cylinders or rupturing filling hoses. Controlled air release to the housing side reduces the risk for operators. Both versions are portable and suitable for mobile use in vehicles. Forklift recesses on all housing sides enable easy handling.
Safety doors: The explosion-proof doors of the B-SAFE reliably secure the filling area. On the B-SAFE 300, the lock engages automatically during filling to prevent incorrect operation. The B-SAFE ECO is equipped with a mechanical safety lock that also prevents opening during operation.
Filling control: The B-SAFE 300 is equipped with a user-friendly touchscreen control with plain text display of all operating parameters. The B-SAFE ECO is manually operated and equipped with three pressure gauges for pressure control. Both versions provide safe and efficient control of the filling process.
Filling options: The B-SAFE 300 is equipped with a user-friendly touchscreen control with plain text display of all operating parameters. The B-SAFE ECO is manually operated and equipped with three pressure gauges for pressure control. Both versions provide safe and efficient control of the filling process.
Options: Proportional valve
For sensitive composite cylinders, the B-SAFE 300 can be equipped with an electronically controlled proportional valve. It allows a defined, medium filling speed between 20 and 50 bar/min, thus preventing pressure surges and time-consuming repressurizing.: Scope of delivery
Scope of delivery B-SAFE 300 with filling hoses: Safety cell with explosion-proof, automatically locking doors
Footnotes: 6 to 10 filling connections available

In combination with additional filling panels, the MAXI filling panel is ideally suited for setting up a filling line with an alternative filling pressure (e.g., additional MIDI filling panels with 300 and 200 bar).
The filling pressure in the pressure vessel is displayed via a pressure gauge in bar/psi.
Details & Features
The B-MASTER MINI, MIDI, and MAXI filling panels are purpose-built for the filling of compressed air cylinders used in paintball sports. They enable safe and efficient filling of bottles ranging from 0.8 to 1.9 liters at 200 or 300 bar. The system is designed for external mounting and can be expanded using T-pieces – ideal for multi-table setups.
The rugged filling coupling with integrated check valve fits all standard paintball nipples and prevents the hose from whipping if triggered without a connected marker. An integrated silencer reduces noise when venting the hose.

In heartfelt speeches, BAUER’s “First
Family” warmly thanked the employ­
ees for all their efforts in the pre-
vious two difficult years, and hailed
the extremely positive prospects for
BAUER in the future, based on the
company’s financial results and the
stream of new product developments.
At dinner a lavish selection of Bavar­ian
specialities and drinks were served,
accompanied by a musical programme
featuring a traditional brass band,
then a DJ to keep the party mood in
full swing. A hugely popular photo
booth invited guests to dress up in fun
accessories and snap themselves. But
the real star of the event was Heinz
Bauer, who was fittingly celebrated by
the guests and employees on this
special occasion. They had put heart,
soul and plenty of effort into assem-
bling a varied series of entertaining
skits, sketches, songs and videos.
Heinz Bauer himself was clearly
thoroughly amused by the many
self-penned songs, medleys and films
offering imaginative and humorous
looks at this exceptional and many-
faceted personality in the finest BAUER
tradition. When the event came to a
close at around 11 pm, it had been a
great evening full of memories to
treasure, as the departing guests
unanimously agreed.

1: Details & Features
The modular storage system is the ideal supplement for compressor units and ensures stable pressure supply for air and Nitrox applications. Available in pressure levels of 330, 350, and 420 bar, it minimizes pressure fluctuations during peak withdrawals and reduces the number of compressor start-ups.: Flexible expansion using 50- or 80-liter storage cylinders allows the system to be tailored precisely to individual demand, supporting smooth and efficient operation.
Storage cylinder with console: A module consists of a storage cylinder that is pre-piped and ready for connection, mounted on a console for floor or wall installation. Based on 50 l or 80 l storage cylinders, these storage systems can be expanded as required.
Pressure vessel: The storage cylinders comply with DGRL2014/68/EU (PED) and are intended for stationary applications.
Condensate drain: Depending on the application or due to insufficient air or gas treatment, condensate can accumulate in high-pressure storage systems. All standard storage vessels from BAUER KOMPRESSOREN are therefore equipped with a manual condensate drain.
Options: Safety valve and pressure gauge
Safety valve and pressure gauge are mounted on the console of the first module. This is mandatory if exceeding the maximum permissible storage pressure cannot be otherwise avoided, e.g. by approved safety valves on the compressor or in the pipeline.: The storage design
Storage system design – the basis for efficient compressor operation: A correctly dimensioned storage system is one of the key components of a high-pressure setup. It reduces pressure fluctuations during intermittent air withdrawal and decreases compressor start frequency by providing sufficient storage capacity. The pressure vessels and final separators in high-pressure compressors are designed for a limited number of load cycles. Fewer start-stop cycles significantly extend the service life of these components.
To ensure optimal operation, the compressor should ideally run no more than two to four cycles per hour. BAUER industrial compressors are equipped with cycle counters as standard, which record actual start cycles and support safe, efficient system control.: The size of the storage system depends on:
Compressor delivery rate (l/min): Air consumption of the specific application
Pressure differential between start and stop (hysteresis): Simplified formula for sizing a high-pressure storage system (based on 4 load cycles/hour):
Vk (l/min): Compressor delivery volume in liters per minute: V (l): Storage volume in liters (water volume)
Δp (bar): Pressure differential (hysteresis) in bar: We recommend a pressure differential Δp of max. 60 bar for continuous operation. Within this range, stationary high-pressure storage cylinders are typically rated for continuous duty. For higher differentials, the number of allowable filling cycles is limited. Please refer to the documentation for the specific pressure vessel.

175 cm × 60 cm × 135 cm: Details & Features
The B-SAFE 300 is a fully enclosed high-pressure filling chamber designed for the simultaneous filling of up to ten breathing air cylinders at pressures of up to 410 bar. Its rugged design and lateral pressure relief ensure maximum safety – without requiring additional protective measures in the room. Operation is via a touchscreen control panel, optionally with a proportional valve for standards-compliant filling of lightweight cylinders.: The B-SAFE ECO is a compact safety chamber designed for direct compressor connection, offering maximum safety with minimal space requirements. Equipped with a mechanical door lock, modern venting technology, and internal pressure relief, it is ideal for container-based and stationary installations. It accommodates up to six breathing air cylinders.
Safety cell: The B-SAFE features an extremely robust steel safety cell that reliably protects against the consequences of bursting cylinders or rupturing filling hoses. Controlled air release to the housing side reduces the risk for operators. Both versions are portable and suitable for mobile use in vehicles. Forklift recesses on all housing sides enable easy handling.
Safety doors: The explosion-proof doors of the B-SAFE reliably secure the filling area. On the B-SAFE 300, the lock engages automatically during filling to prevent incorrect operation. The B-SAFE ECO is equipped with a mechanical safety lock that also prevents opening during operation.
Filling control: The B-SAFE 300 is equipped with a user-friendly touchscreen control with plain text display of all operating parameters. The B-SAFE ECO is manually operated and equipped with three pressure gauges for pressure control. Both versions provide safe and efficient control of the filling process.
Filling options: The B-SAFE 300 is equipped with a user-friendly touchscreen control with plain text display of all operating parameters. The B-SAFE ECO is manually operated and equipped with three pressure gauges for pressure control. Both versions provide safe and efficient control of the filling process.
Options: Proportional valve
For sensitive composite cylinders, the B-SAFE 300 can be equipped with an electronically controlled proportional valve. It allows a defined, medium filling speed between 20 and 50 bar/min, thus preventing pressure surges and time-consuming repressurizing.: Scope of delivery
Scope of delivery B-SAFE 300 with filling hoses: Safety cell with explosion-proof, automatically locking doors
Footnotes: 6 to 10 filling connections available

Details & Features
The B-MASTER MINI, MIDI, and MAXI filling panels are purpose-built for the filling of compressed air cylinders used in paintball sports. They enable safe and efficient filling of bottles ranging from 0.8 to 1.9 liters at 200 or 300 bar. The system is designed for external mounting and can be expanded using T-pieces – ideal for multi-table setups.
The rugged filling coupling with integrated check valve fits all standard paintball nipples and prevents the hose from whipping if triggered without a connected marker. An integrated silencer reduces noise when venting the hose.
